card.name: Just before cosmetic or contact-lens terms
card.fires_on: Words like avoid, wearing, remove, use of, or after, right before an expected cosmetics or contact-lens word. Mostly in instructions about what to avoid, take off, or not apply during treatment.

modes.label: The warning about wearing lenses
modes.description: The word wearing after avoid, just before contact lenses.
modes.example: and to avoid<< wearing>> contact lenses for the duration of therapy.

modes.label: Skin and hair product cautions
modes.description: Linking words in lists of products or treatments to avoid, where cosmetics may come next.
modes.example: Applied to the scalp in the 12 hours before or<< after>> any chemical treatments to the hair.

modes.label: The instruction to remove items
modes.description: Verbs about removing items or clothing before a procedure.
modes.example: - You will be asked to<< remove>> clothing and be given a gown to wear

card.writes: It makes the model more likely to write cos, as in cosmetics, next.
